title: Development and validation of a deep learning-based model to distinguish acetabular fractures on pelvic anteroposterior radiographs.
summary: A deep-learning model distinguishes acetabular fractures on pelvic AP radiographs and is validated against clinicians and separate data; the paper reports diagnostic comparison on a specific fracture question. This is retrospective diagnostic validation, not prospective clinical benefit.
ai_technology: DenseNet-169-based model classifies acetabular fracture images.
